question: In the sodium chlorate droplet crystallization experiments, what droplet volume was dispensed, and on what size of substrate?
expect: 5 uL droplets on 5 mm x 5 mm silicon substrates (Experimental Setup)
rendered:
<document title="Evaporative Crystallization of Sodium Chlorate Droplets under Controlled Humidity in the Presence of a Static Magnetic Field">

=== page 2 ===
- Droplets of 5 μL were deposited onto 5 mm × 5 mm silicon substrate, which were pre-equilibrated at the evaporation temperature (T) for 30 min.

The answer is: 5 μL on a 5 mm × 5 mm silicon substrate.
